title: Signal PDU: Cache get_signal_value_name_config results
description:
By profiling Wireshark, I noticed that, in my use case, it spent a long time in `get_signal_value_name_config`, due to the costly `g_hash_table_lookup`.

The idea is to cache the results so that a lookup is not needed every time.

But this also means that `data_spdu_signal_list` and `data_spdu_signal_value_names` need to be invalidated at the same time, since one references the other.
